summary: Scope expansion ratified by the Owner on 2026-11-03 within the bounded, documented scope. scope_providers now includes ALPACA_BASIC, ALPACA_HISTORICAL, MARKETDATA_APP_FREE and FRANKFURTER_ECB_FX. Every provider right remains UNKNOWN until the Owner attests entitlement, display, calculation, derived-value and cache permissions separately; no provider is READY or activated by ratification alone.

proposed_scope_entries.label: REALTIME_IEX_ONLY — single-venue last trade, never FULL_MARKET_REALTIME
proposed_scope_entries.account_entitlement: UNKNOWN — Basic plan IEX feed; must verify against the actual account tier
UNKNOWN — Basic plan allows delayed SIP bars; must verify against actual account tier
proposed_scope_entries.permitted_egress_fields: symbols (public identifiers), timeframe, start, end, limit, feed, adjustment

proposed_scope_entries.authentication: Authorization header only. The token is never a URL query parameter, so it cannot reach a URL log, proxy log or browser history.
proposed_scope_entries.documented_response: s, symbol[], last[], updated[] index-aligned; updated is Unix seconds; HTTP 200 and 203 are success; no_data and error are handled explicitly
proposed_scope_entries.delay_policy: Free Forever is delayed at least 24 hours. 'last' is a delayed last trade and is never labelled an official completed-session EOD close.
proposed_scope_entries.quota_policy: 100 credits/day, one credit per requested symbol, reserved before the request; window opens 09:30 America/New_York (not 00:00 UTC); counter persisted atomically so restarts cannot re-spend it
proposed_scope_entries.account_entitlement: UNKNOWN — Free Forever plan; must be confirmed against the actual account
proposed_scope_entries.display_permitted: UNKNOWN — personal localhost Dashboard usage noted in ToS 2026-10-26; exchange-level rights still govern
proposed_scope_entries.derived_value_permitted: UNKNOWN — no Derived Works/NAV restriction found in Free Plan ToS as of 2026-10-26; exchange-level rights still apply
proposed_scope_entries.cache_permitted: UNKNOWN — Free plan data retainable while account open per ToS 2026-10-26; exact exchange-level restrictions not verified

proposed_scope_entries.documented_response: {"date", "base", "quote", "rate"} — a single scalar rate for the requested pair; the earlier nested rates.ECB assumption was wrong and is removed
proposed_scope_entries.alignment_policy: As-of requests carry the valuation date; the returned source date is preserved, weekends and holidays are reported as unavailable rather than substituted, and no future observation is accepted
proposed_scope_entries.account_entitlement: UNKNOWN — keyless API; no account required per published documentation
proposed_scope_entries.label: REFERENCE_FX_NOT_EXECUTABLE — not a Dime! or broker executable rate

activation_prerequisites_per_provider: Owner verifies actual account entitlement for each provider
Owner attests display_permitted, calculation_permitted, derived_value_permitted, cache_permitted and retention_policy_verified in the scope_providers entry

Credentials stored through SETUP-MARKET-DATA.bat (Windows Credential Manager, target ACASH/MARKET_DATA/<PROVIDER_ID>); ALPACA_HISTORICAL reuses the ALPACA_BASIC read-only alias and gains no entitlement from it
FRANKFURTER_ECB_FX is keyless but still needs the attestation above before any outbound request

Documented-contract verification is separate from live verification: MARKETDATA_LIVE_RESPONSE_VERIFIED and FRANKFURTER_LIVE_RESPONSE_VERIFIED stay False until the Owner observes a real authorized response
A provider becomes READY only when market_authority reports every gate true; the Dashboard must then show LIVE = NOT_OBSERVED until a real response is recorded
owner_decision_wording: I ratify ODR_UPI_MARKET_DATA_004_AMENDMENT_001: scope_providers now lists ALPACA_BASIC, ALPACA_HISTORICAL, MARKETDATA_APP_FREE and FRANKFURTER_ECB_FX for owner-local market-data retrieval only. This ratifies the scope, not any vendor grant: every entitlement, display, calculation, derived-value, cache and retention right stays UNKNOWN and the provider stays disabled until I attest it separately against the applicable agreement. No trading, broker connectivity, capital transfer, paid subscription or live-response claim is authorized by this record.
not_authorized_by_this_proposal: Marking any right as VERIFIED without Owner-supplied evidence
Activating any live network request (adapters gate on MARKETDATA_CONTRACT_VERIFIED and FRANKFURTER_CONTRACT_VERIFIED)

MARKETDATA_APP_FREE.documented_contract: array parser, Bearer authentication, 100 credits/day with a 09:30 America/New_York window and a persisted counter
MARKETDATA_APP_FREE.mock_tests: 12 tests passing (index alignment, no_data/error, duplicates, future timestamps, HTTP 200/203, credit window, DST, restart, concurrency, no secret in URL)

FRANKFURTER_ECB_FX.documented_contract: V2 scalar {date, base, quote, rate} with an optional as-of date; the earlier nested rates.ECB assumption was removed
FRANKFURTER_ECB_FX.mock_tests: 9 tests passing (scalar parse both directions, pair mismatch, future date, as-of request, rejected nested envelope, keyless readiness, no secret in URL)
